title: 8 field-cube components with two-sided bounded search

claims.statement: The explicit 8-component degree-125 field-cube encoder with its stated two-sided radius-15/13 decoder for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses has average block error at most 21654918317810381/25000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 two-sided decoder uses at most W=26890026728831797629832 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(7451/100).

experiments.purpose: Check exact digit-coefficient imbalance envelopes, occupied-volume error, field irreducibility, fixed root circuit and both search counts.
